```python
import json
import requests

# Search arXiv API for multimodal RAG papers without urllib.parse
base_url = 'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query'
search_query = 'all:"multimodal RAG" OR all:"multimodal retrieval augmented generation"'
query_params = f'search_query={search_query}&start=0&max_results=15&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
url = base_url + '?' + query_params.replace(' ', '%20').replace(':', '%3A').replace('"', '%22')

response = requests.get(url)
print(f"Status: {response.status_code}")
print(f"Response length: {len(response.text)}")
# Save response to file for parsing
with open('arxiv_response.xml', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(response.text)
print("Saved to arxiv_response.xml")
print(response.text[:1000])
```
